annotations.text:
FREELANCER — one task, not a list
Your screenshot showed 9 cards and only 1 you could act on. This shows exactly one.
The 8 UP NEXT cards become one line: "2 more after this".
Phone first, because they are not at a desk.
Try it: pick a date, paste a link, submit. The next task slides in.

NEW VIDEO — the fix you picked
Nothing enters anyone's list half-finished, so a dead "Submit for review" button stops existing.
The 4 people are pre-filled from the category defaults you already have. Change the category and watch them refill.
The footer names what is still missing instead of blocking silently.
Try it: clear a person, or type in the description.

CONTROL ROOM — one rule set, numbers that add up
Your two systems disagreed (Overdue 5 / Ready Idle 4 vs Needs a nudge 5). These four buckets are mutually exclusive, so they always sum to the unfinished total.
The 65 published videos are hidden by default — that was 88% of your scroll.
Every stage column sorts again.
Try it: click a tile, click a stage header, show published.

ONE VIDEO — approve in two clicks
Only the stage that needs a human opens. Finished stages are one line.
The affiliate-link generator moves out to the Links tab, which cuts the 844-line panel roughly in half.
Try it: Approve, or Ask for changes.
